units.source_text: 阿光开始听见有人哗啷啷地转动着细钢丝编结的筒状器具炒豆子的声音。

en.t: A Guang began to hear the sound of someone rattling a cylindrical tool woven from fine steel wire as they roasted beans.

units.source_text: 隔着马戏团帐篷前的马路，她看见对面一个女人用右手摇动着器具，

en.t: Across the road in front of the circus tent, she saw a woman opposite her shaking the tool with her right hand,

units.source_text: 露出一只瘪气球似的乳房，让章鱼头般的幼婴吸吮着。

en.t: with one breast like a deflated balloon exposed, letting an infant with an octopus-like head suck at it.

units.source_text: 她丈夫在同一个摊上用长铜火筷灵巧地翻动着网上的栗子。

en.t: Her husband, at the same stall, was deftly turning chestnuts on the grill with long copper fire tongs.
